instruction.name: vpickve2gr.hu
instruction.description: Pick the 16-bit element at lane `idx` from `a`, zero-extend it to the GPR width, and store it in `dst`.

latencies.notes: vj -> rd. Chain: vreplgr2vr.h then vpickve2gr.hu; the 2-cycle latency of the replication helper is subtracted (calibrated with vpickve2gr.b/h and xvpickve2gr.d/w). Three independent runs, spread 6.00-6.00 raw cycles.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vpickve2gr.hu $r12, $vr8, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r13, $vr9, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r14, $vr10, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r15, $vr11, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r16, $vr12, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r17, $vr13, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r18, $vr14, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r19, $vr15, 0
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vpickve2gr.hu $r12, $vr8, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r13, $vr9, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r14, $vr10, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r15, $vr11, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r16, $vr12, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r17, $vr13, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r18, $vr14, 0; vpickve2gr.hu $r19, $vr15, 0'

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
